title: Give a friendly error page
summary: Flask: Give a friendly error page. Try a different unknown URL.
introduction: An error handler formats a known error. GET /missing uses abort to raise a 404.
learningObjectives: Give a friendly error page with Flask

blocks.text: In a practice folder create a virtual environment and install Flask with python -m pip install flask. Save one example as app.py and run python app.py. Use http://127.0.0.1:8000.

blocks.title: Give a friendly error page

blocks.text: abort raises a 404 HTTP error. The registered handler replaces its body while keeping 404.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Keep the error status when returning a friendly error body.
